record.question: The earliest composition among the four Vedas is:
record.answerKeyRef: MCS Provisional ( Preliminary ) - 2025 Answer Key Paper-I..pdf
record.explanation:
Among the four Vedas, the Rig Veda is regarded as the oldest. IGNCA’s overview says it is the oldest among the Vedas and describes its collection of hymns; the Sama, Yajur, and Atharva Vedas are later or have distinct ritual roles in that tradition. The question concerns relative composition order, not which Veda is most widely used today.

Reference: https://ignca.gov.in/a-glimpse-of-vedic-literature/
